headline: Iran's Massive Mourning Signals Regime Resilience Amid Rising Regional Tensions
subheadline: IDF reports killing a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon near the buffer zone, escalating cross-border tensions as Iranian crowds gather in Tehran.
lede: In Tehran, massive crowds mourned Ayatollah Khamenei, demonstrating sustained public support for the Iranian regime while Trump said the U.S. could eliminate Iranian officials at the funeral but declined, opting for future negotiations. The IDF reported killing a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon near the buffer zone, and Gaza saw large explosions from building demolitions, raising concerns about ongoing conflict and potential escalation. In Ukraine, forces retained control of Konstantinivka in Donetsk Oblast amid northern sector battles, while Russian strikes on Sumy's infrastructure caused significant residential damage and injuries, including children. Ukrainian authorities authorized export of F10 combat drones to the U.S. military, and Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 59 drones and 26 command posts over the Moscow region, whereas Russian attacks damaged industrial zones in Dnipro and Belgorod, causing civilian injuries and power/water outages.

sections.title: Ukrainian Holdfast Amid Russian Strikes and Drone Gains
sections.body: Ukrainian forces maintain control over Konstantinivka in Donetsk Oblast, with ongoing battles reported in the city's northern sector. Russian strikes on Sumy's infrastructure caused significant damage to residential areas and injuries, including children, while attacks on Dnipro's industrial zones injured four civilians, also including children. Ukraine authorized the export of F10 combat drones to the U.S. military under the Drone Dominance program, and Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 59 drones and 26 command posts over the Moscow region. Russian missile strikes damaged infrastructure in Belgorod, resulting in power and water outages for local residents.

sections.title: Iranian Mourning Fuels Regional Escalation and Tensions
sections.body: Massive crowds gathered in Tehran to mourn Ayatollah Khamenei, indicating sustained public support for the Iranian regime. Trump stated the U.S. could eliminate Iranian officials at the funeral but refused, choosing to prioritize future negotiations instead. The IDF reported killing a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon near the buffer zone, while Gaza saw large explosions from building demolitions, raising concerns about ongoing conflict. Israeli officials debated military options against Iran, discussing a potential third war, as analysts emphasized Iranian resilience despite recent US and Israeli attacks.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's demonstrated regime resilience, evidenced by massive mourning crowds, coupled with Israeli strikes on Hezbollah in Lebanon, raises the risk of further regional escalation. Ukraine's expanding drone production for U.S. forces and successful interceptions over Moscow contrast with continued Russian attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure, indicating a shifting but still contested balance. The convergence of heightened Middle East tensions and persistent Ukrainian frontline pressures suggests an overall increase in instability across both theaters.
